## Summary

Describe the change and the user/problem it addresses.

## Safety

- [ ] Read-only only, or mutation behavior explicitly documented
- [ ] No network/AI dependency added to core
- [ ] No hard-coded customer/template node IDs
- [ ] Tests added/updated
- [ ] Build/typecheck/tests pass

## Memory-bank

- [ ] `PROJECT_STATE.md` updated if state changed
- [ ] `NEXT_ACTIONS.md` updated
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated
- [ ] `DECISIONS.md` updated if a durable decision changed

## Validation

Explain how this was tested and which fixture(s) were used.
